author: Sarah Jenkins
review_text: Revio completely streamlined our multi-location Google review monitoring. The automated alerts are instantaneous and our team responded 4x faster.

author: Marcus Vance
review_text: Unacceptable server outage during our holiday marketing campaign. Your dashboard was unreachable for 4 hours and support took 2 days to reply. We are considering terminating our enterprise contract immediately.

author: Priya Sharma
review_text: The maintenance ticket feature in TenantEase is full of bugs. I logged an urgent water leakage 3 days ago, and the landlord app showed no notification. Fix your notification delivery!

author: David Miller
review_text: TenantEase made rent payments and lease renewal seamless. Love the automated rent reminders and receipt generation. Best property app we've used.

author: Elena Rostova
review_text: The engineering team developed our custom AI agent workflow within 6 weeks. The engineering quality, AWS cloud architecture, and communication were world-class.

author: Rajiv Mehta
review_text: The web app delivered was technically solid and fast, but the initial onboarding and milestone documentation were delayed. Pricing is slightly on the higher side.

author: Chloe Dupont
review_text: Great sentiment analysis accuracy and clean dashboard UI. Would love to see deeper WhatsApp integration for sending direct review request links.

author: Amir Khan
review_text: Total scam. I was double-charged for my October maintenance fee and your payment gateway showed failed transaction. I want an immediate refund or I will file a bank chargeback.

author: Liam O'Connor
review_text: Solid platform for managing review velocity. Helps us gather customer feedback seamlessly. Customer support agent Neha was very helpful resolving our webhook issue.

author: Vikram Singhania
review_text: Outstanding autonomous AI agent integration! The team transformed our manual customer triage into an automated 24/7 intelligent pipeline. High ROI.

author: Jessica Taylor
review_text: The AI auto-response feature is too robotic and repeats the exact same phrases. It doesn't capture nuanced feedback about pricing dissatisfaction. Needs better prompt controls.

author: Carlos Gomez
review_text: Smooth UI and easy lease document signing. Sometimes takes a few seconds to load floor plans, but overall great experience.

author: Deepak Verma
review_text: Security issue! Our staging database credentials were leaked in the public git repository during their early deployment test. Unacceptable lack of basic security protocols.

author: Ananya Roy
review_text: Incredible time saver for agencies handling 20+ client profiles. The multi-tenant workspace and review sentiment aggregator are top-notch.

author: Emily Watson
review_text: Decent app for paying rent, but customer service chatbot cannot resolve simple parking allocation questions and keeps looping.
